title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (August 2026)
summary: A Hacker News community discussion thread where users share what projects they're working on and topics they're exploring. This monthly 'Ask HN' tradition generates organic conversations about personal projects, research interests, and emerging tech trends.
problem_solved: Facilitates knowledge sharing and networking within the tech community by providing an open forum for discussing ongoing projects and curiosities.
why_valuable: Creates opportunities for collaboration, feedback, and discovery of emerging trends and ideas from developers and tech enthusiasts worldwide.
